title: Home · Energy & water

panels.title: Spot price now

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Helsinki")
from(bucket: "nordpool")
  |> range(start: -2h, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "price" and r._field == "price")

panels.title: Use vs weather-expected (30-day)

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Helsinki")

used =
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electricity" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> set(key: "series", value: "Used")
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> group()
  |> timedMovingAverage(every: 1d, period: 30d)
exp =
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fmi_daily" and r.param == "tday")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d), _value: 19.9 + 1.86 * (if r._value < 10.5 then 10.5 - r._value else 0.0), series: "Expected from weather"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> group()
  |> timedMovingAverage(every: 1d, period: 30d)
join(tables: {u: used, e: exp}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value_u / r._value_e}))

panels.description: Above 100 % means more electricity than the 2021–2024 house used in the same weather: a new always-on load, the electric heater, or a less efficient heat pump.

panels.title: Your CO₂, last 12 months

targets.query:
hourly = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -365d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fingrid_hourly" and r.series == "co2_consumption")
live = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -365d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fingrid" and r.series == "co2_consumption")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
co2 = union(tables: [hourly, live])
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "c")
use = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -365d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electricity" and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "u")
union(tables: [use, co2])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u and exists r.c)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.u * r.c / 1000.0}))
  |> sum()
